recipe:
if [ mockmatched = data_covariance ]; then
  cp results/preprint_v2/covariances/pure_eb_covariance.npz results/preprint_v2/covariances/pure_eb_covariance_reference.npz
else
  bash src/papers/bmodes/scripts/run_pure_eb_covariance.sh \
    --version "$(python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/catalog_versions.py size_cut applied)" --blind "$(python src/workflow/scripts/decision_values.py fiducial_blind blind_a)" \
    --cat-config src/cosmo_val/cat_config.yaml \
    --xi-reporting results/preprint_v2/catalog_processing/xi_reporting.txt \
    --xi-integration results/preprint_v2/catalog_processing/xi_integration.txt \
    --cov-integration results/preprint_v2/covariances/cov_integration_reference.txt \
    --integration-method adaptive_dqags \
    --integration-limits reporting_extent \
    --rebinning-weights none \
    --covariance-method monte_carlo \
    --out-file results/preprint_v2/covariances/pure_eb_covariance_reference.npz
fi
